links.comparator_used: Routine reporting pathway (cases with even case numbers reported in standard order without AI prioritisation)
links.outcome: Reporting turnaround time for clinically significant duodenal biopsy diagnoses
links.effect: Coeliac disease reported in 6 days vs 10 days; non-neoplastic abnormalities as a group in 7 days vs 10 days (both p<0.005); neoplastic lesions not reported quicker
links.tradeoff: AI processing took about 70 s per slide; adenocarcinoma sensitivity was only 50.0% (PPV 100%); no turnaround benefit for neoplastic lesions; cost of deployment and operation described as reasonable
links.quote: In the AI triage workstream coeliac disease, and non-neoplastic abnormalities as a group, were reported quicker than in the standard workstream (6 days vs 10 days and 7 days vs 10 days, respectively, both p<0.005), but neoplastic lesions were not reported quicker.

design_hint: AI-based prioritisation (triage) of cases in reporting workflow, compared with routine pathway
